mechanisms.reason: Elasticsearch Query DSL cannot compare a string's length without scripts, and the adapter is handed a plan rather than a mapping, so it cannot tell size(aString) from size(tagNames): size() over a field the caller has declared neither in nestedPaths nor in collectionFields is refused before the threshold is examined

mechanisms.message: Collection macros over flat scalar arrays cannot preserve per-element predicates without a nested mapping
mechanisms.reason: A flat scalar array has no per-element query scope: bool.must_not of a term excludes mixed arrays containing both matching and nonmatching elements, whereas CEL exists with a negated body accepts a nonmatching element. This requires nested element documents or scripts, neither supplied by the flat-array mapping.
